entries.title: Psalms 76:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. For stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. God [is] known in Judah, His name is great in Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 76:2
segments: And His abode is in Salem; and His dwelling-place in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 76:3
segments: There He broke the fiery arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 76:4
segments: You [are] more glorious [and] excellent than the mountains of prey.

entries.title: Psalms 76:5
segments: The stouthearted have been stripped; they slept their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.

entries.title: Psalms 76:6
segments: By Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the horse and the chariot have sunk into a sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 76:7
segments: You, [even] You, [are] terrifying, and who can stand when once You are angry?

entries.title: Psalms 76:8
segments: You cause judgment to be heard from Heaven; the earth feared and was still,

entries.title: Psalms 76:9
segments: when God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 76:10
segments: Surely the wrath of man shall praise You; the wrath that is left, You shall bind up.

entries.title: Psalms 76:11
segments: Vow, and pay to the LORD your God; let all that are around Him bring presents to the Fearful One.

entries.title: Psalms 76:12
segments: He shall cut off the spirit in princes; [He is] feared by the kings of the earth.
